ok I need to vent and I need yall's help with something. this is my personal page on purpose, the shop has nothing to do with this one.

a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co is selling my switchblade moth. the one I drew for the sept 13 flash sheet. I posted the sheet on aug 30, you can scroll back and see it. they have it listed as "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal," $6.50 or 3 for $15. a friend sent me the listing tonight because someone in her family bought one for a water bottle.

and it's not "similar." it's the same crack in the blade. same wing pattern. they didn't even flip it. it's not "inspired by" anything, it's my linework. I drew that whole sheet over like 3 weekends at my kitchen table and this is the thing I was proudest of all year.

so I messaged them, nicely, with the date and the original drawing and asked them to take it down. their reply was "love your work!" (cool, thanks) and then that moths are a very common motif (they are! that's not what this is) and that if I have a registered copyright I can send it through their support form. so basically, nice to meet you, pound sand.

here's why that reply made me so mad. they know exactly what they're doing. small artists don't have lawyer money and sticker places know that. the whole plan is that you'll get tired and go away. I'm not gonna, but I know a lot of you are artists who've been through this or will be, so I'm saying it out loud.

second thing, and this one matters to me. flash gets sold ONE time to ONE person. that's the whole deal. somebody pays for that design, it goes on their body, and nobody else gets it. that's what the client is paying for. so when I found out the moth was now a $6.50 sticker, my first thought was the person who actually got it tattooed. she saw one in the wild tonight and reached out to me, confused and upset, and honestly I don't blame her one bit. so to her and to anybody else who got a flash piece from me: I did not sell this. I didn't license it, I didn't know about it, and I would never do that to you. your tattoo is still one of one. the shop copied it and I'm handling it.

what I'm asking:

- if you have a minute, go report the listing. search StickerBurrow Co and look for the Knife Moth Vinyl Decal. report it as a copyright / stolen artwork violation on whatever platform it's on. the more reports the better.
- don't buy from them. I know it's a cute sticker, I'm biased, but please don't.
- if you see my work anywhere I didn't put it, tell me. DM me, send the link.
- and if you're an artist with a flash sheet, date your posts and save your originals. I did, and it's the only reason I can prove any of this.

I'm not trying to start a witch hunt or have anyone harass the people who work there. I just want the listing gone and I want people to know what happened. report the listing, that's it. that's the ask.

I'll update when I hear anything. thank you to everyone who has already sent me kind words. I'm still pissed but at least I'm not alone in it lol

rant over (for now)

reasons: It omits that the client got the tattoo in the first hour.
